Alex (Infra): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands reliability segment — compiling risks/asks and owners here.
Maya (Reliability): Thanks. Can we get the RCA link? I missed the exact pointer.
Alex (Infra): Here: https://redwood.in/rca/inc-2026-shard-saturation — doc has timeline + logs; action items below.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): FYI the main cause looked like batched-request pileups when host VMs hit GPU memory limits.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): snippet of log we saw:
```
2026-04-12T15:02:11Z WARN queue_length=142 batch_size=64 model=redwood/3b qv=0.9
2026-04-12T15:02:12Z ERROR kv_cache_alloc_failed
```
Maya (Reliability): Assigning owners: model-serving (Jordan) to own adaptive batching prototype; SLO playbook update (Maya).
Emily (Product): Quick product question — does this change our roadmap for Dedicated customers?
Alex (Infra): No roadmap rework. We'll add an autoscale 'safe mode' toggle in 2.3 (ETA 2026-05-14) and communicate to tenants.
SRE Bot: Incident bot: RCA doc updated by Alex — https://redwood.in/rca/inc-2026-shard-saturation
Jordan (Eng Runtime): Proposed fixes: cap batch_size per-model, early KV cache eviction, and backpressure at router.
Maya (Reliability): Action items I'm recording here:
 - Implement adaptive batching prototype — owner: Jordan — due: 2026-05-10
 - Update SLO/runbooks and postmortem summaries — owner: Maya — due: 2026-05-12
 - Canary + traffic guard for autoscale changes — owner: Alex — due: 2026-05-06
Alex (Infra): Created GH issues and linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/448
Jordan (Eng Runtime): I'll add perf baselines + stress test artifacts to the issue; will post in #eng-runtime.
Emily (Product): Product asks: draft a proactive customer notice for Dedicated customers offering opt-in rate-limiting; can someone draft a comms PR?
Maya (Reliability): I can draft the comms by Friday EOD.
Alex (Infra): Triage sync tomorrow 10:30 PT — who can join? Please RSVP with :thumbsup: here.
Jordan (Eng Runtime): +1 I'll join.
Emily (Product): +1
SRE Bot: Reminder: triage-sync calendar invite created — https://calendar.google.com/meet/abc123
Alex (Infra): Final: please add 'status' label (blocked/in-progress/done) to GH issues. I'll show updates in the biweekly ops review.
Maya (Reliability): Noted. Thanks everyone. :pray:
